code: basins <- file.path(tempdir(), "basins") set.seed(2024) n <- 24 * 60 time <- seq(as.POSIXct("2023-10-01", tz = "UTC"), by = 3600, length.out = n) truths <- list() for (i in 1:8) {   id <- sprintf("B%02d", i)   folder <- file.path(basins, id)   dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)   wet <- stats::runif(1, 0.04, 0.09)   forcing <- data.frame(     time = format(time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),     rain = ifelse(stats::runif(n) < wet, stats::rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = stats::runif(1, 2, 4)), 0),     pet = round(stats::runif(1, 0.04, 0.09), 3)   )   truth <- pdm_presets("standard")   truth$area_km2 <- round(stats::runif(1, 10, 200))   truth$fc <- stats::runif(1, 0.9, 1.2)   truth$distribution$cmax <- stats::runif(1, 80, 250)   truth$recharge$kg <- exp(stats::runif(1, log(20), log(300)))   k <- sort(stats::runif(2, 1, 12))   truth$surface$k1 <- k[1]   truth$surface$k2 <- k[2]   truths[[id]] <- truth   flow <- run_pdm(pdm_from_config(truth), forcing[, c("rain", "pet")])$output$q_m3s *     exp(stats::rnorm(n, 0, 0.04))   if (id == "B06") forcing$pet[100:110] <- -0.05   data.table::fwrite(forcing, file.path(folder, "forcing.csv"))   data.table::fwrite(data.frame(q_m3s = flow), file.path(folder, "flow.csv"))   writeLines(c(     paste("catchment:", paste("Example", id)),     paste("gauge:", id),     paste("area_km2:", truth$area_km2),     "calibration: [2023-10-11, 2023-11-14]",     "validation: [2023-11-15, 2023-11-29]"   ), file.path(folder, "basin.yml")) } list.files(basins) #> [1] "B01" "B02" "B03" "B04" "B05" "B06" "B07" "B08" cat(readLines(file.path(basins, "B01", "basin.yml")), sep = "\n") #> catchment: Example B01 #> gauge: B01 #> area_km2: 80 #> calibration: [2023-10-11, 2023-11-14] #> validation: [2023-11-15, 2023-11-29]
